cases.refreshed: Come join us every Tuesday for Baby Lapsit Storytime. Baby Lapsit invites newborns, infants, babies, and their caregivers to learn together by strengthening their relationship with each other through stories, songs, bounces, tickles, rhymes, books, and play. After storytime concludes, we invite you to Stay & Play. The storytime librarian will join in the fun with special toys, giving babies and parents time to connect. Lapsit Storytime 11 to 11:30 a.m. Stay & Play: 11:30 a.m. to noon. Please note that this will be an indoor program. Seating for storytime is available on a first-come, first-served basis. A limited number of tickets will be distributed at the Information Desk 30 minutes prior to the start of Storytime. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: Vietnamese Storytime with Ican welcomes children and their caregivers to participate in early literacy activities in both Vietnamese and English. This program is geared for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers! Free. No registration required. For a complete list of storytimes: sjpl.org/storytimes Giờ kể chuyện song ngữ cùng Ican chào đón trẻ em và các phụ huynh tham gia các hoạt động đọc và viết song ngữ tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh. Chương trình này dành cho trẻ em ở mọi lứa tuổi và phụ huynh/người chăm sóc! Miễn phí. Không cần đăng ký. Để xem danh sách đầy đủ về các chương trình kể chuyện: sjpl.org/storytimes

cases.refreshed: Join us for this teen-oriented book club focusing on manga! Read the first book in the series before the meetup and be ready to discuss the story, artwork, characters, themes and more. The first 5 registrants will receive their very own copy of the first book of the series to keep (you will be notified 1 week before we meet for book club) and you can pick up your copy at the Adult Reference desk (downstairs). This month we will be reading: Komi Can't Communicate Available as a: Book and e Book (Libby)

cases.refreshed: English as a Second Language (ESL) / Learn English: Beyond the Basics is an in-person 8-week class with lessons on English grammar, pronunciation, and idioms. It is for adult (18 years and older) intermediate and advanced English learners who can have a conversation in English and want to improve their pronunciation and understanding. To register for the entire 8-week series, please include your email address and make sure it is entered correctly. Please register only once for the entire series. Please note: Registration closes on the 3rd week of class; Registrants who do not attend by the 2nd week of class may be unregistered.
